Select NIS column groups

Source: R/column-groups.R
nis_vars_design.Rd

Use these tidyselect helpers inside dplyr::select() or the keep argument of nis_design(). Groups use HCUP field names from 2012 onward. Each helper selects the columns present in the input. Combine groups with c() or exclude them with -.

Usage

nis_vars_design()

nis_vars_demographics()

nis_vars_dx()

nis_vars_pr()

nis_vars_hospital()

Value

Tidyselect column positions for the current selection.

Details

  • nis_vars_design() selects YEAR, HOSP_NIS, NIS_STRATUM, DISCWT, and DQTR when available. Include it when projecting a table before building a design. nis_design() checks the four required fields and errors if any are missing. DQTR supports 2015 coverage checks.

  • nis_vars_demographics() selects age, neonatal age indicator, sex, race, expected primary payer, ZIP income quartile, and the applicable urban-rural field.

  • nis_vars_dx() selects numbered ICD-9 and ICD-10 diagnosis, external cause, and present-on-admission fields, plus diagnosis counts and DXVER when present.

  • nis_vars_pr() selects numbered ICD-9 and ICD-10 procedure and procedure-day fields, plus procedure counts and PRVER when present.

  • nis_vars_hospital() selects the hospital identifier and bed size, ownership, location/teaching, region, and division fields. Availability depends on the release and whether the Hospital file was joined.

These helpers match names and do not check how the fields were coded. Diagnosis and procedure groups do not include derived classification fields such as CCS or CCSR.

See also

HCUP NIS File Specifications, HCUP NIS Description of Data Elements.

Examples

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019))
